search_records.abstract:
PURPOSES
Open elbow arthrolysis (OEA) is a common method for treating post-traumatic elbow stiffness, which may lead to severe bleeding when resecting heterotopic ossification (HO) and fibrous scar tissue. The purpose of this study is to compare the efficacy and safety among three different ways of using tranexamic acid (TXA) in reducing total blood loss and drainage volume in OEA.
